name: @openstoa/mls
description: The MLS/TAK crypto, once. Web, mini-app and SDK all import this instead of holding a copy.
//: peerDependencies say WHO must supply the runtime copy: each consumer (web app,
mini-app, SDK) already depends on ts-mls and @noble/ciphers, and a second copy
resolved from here would put two ts-mls in one bundle.
devDependencies exist so THIS package can be typechecked and built on its own.
CI installs each package in isolation, so packages/mls/node_modules is empty and
tsc reported "Cannot find module ts-mls" for every dependent build. Locally it
passed only because the root node_modules happened to satisfy the lookup.
Keep the devDependency ranges in step with the consumers, or the types compiled
here will not be the types the app runs against.
